name: 断门城塞

music.intent: reuse current quiet exploration track for first integration; no new audio runtime

anchor.unlock: consume chapter gate G at [5,2], after mandatory captain

boss.stats: existing floor-10 knight: HP133 ATK38 DEF15; do not substitute golem

palette_direction: warm grey masonry and muted brass throughout this chapter; local props may vary; bright keys and enemies remain legible

zh: 九层红封门的钥匙在这里。
en: A blue key waits on floor four.
The ninth seal needs our red key.

zh: 这把蓝钥匙先开哪一库？
en: Which vault deserves the first key?
Gold alone will not stop a blade.
Count the hits an upgrade will save.

zh: 第二块墙砖藏着旧补给。
en: In the southwest alcove, face south.
The second brick hides our supplies.

zh: 队长身后是下一段阶梯。
石印亮起，这里便能传送。
en: The next stair is behind the captain.
The lit seal opens this warp anchor.
The roll ends the day the gate fell.
The guard has never left his post.

integration_prohibitions: do not add a secret on every floor
do not change item or enemy values to hide integration failures
do not reuse old per-floor key hints
do not ship floors11-50 as part of this map package
